"""Capture bound enforcement: record count and decoded/decompressed bytes."""
import base64, io, json, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
import zstandard as zstd
from common import COLUMNS
from harness import campaign, lease, service, run

HEADER = ','.join(COLUMNS) + '\n'
ROW = 'icmp,a,0,1,put,home,1,0/i1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,echo,,,\n'

def check(label, res, want):
    print('%-32s %s (want %s)' % (label, res, want), 'OK' if res == want else 'MISMATCH')

# 200001 data records -> capture error
t = time.time()
data = HEADER + ROW * 200001
check('200001 records', run(campaign(leases=[lease()], services=[], captures=[
    {'encoding': 'csv', 'chunks': [base64.b64encode(data[i:i+1048576]).decode()
                                   for i in range(0, len(data).real if False else len(data), 1048576)]}]),
    expect_error='capture'), {'error': 'capture'})
print('  (%.1fs)' % (time.time() - t))

# exactly 200000 records -> fine
t = time.time()
data = HEADER + ROW * 200000
res = run(campaign(leases=[lease()], services=[], captures=[
    {'encoding': 'csv', 'chunks': [base64.b64encode(data[i:i+1048576]).decode()
                                   for i in range(0, len(data), 1048576)]}]))
check('200000 records', (len(res['rejected']), res['snapshots'][0]['ledger']['live']), (0, 1))
print('  (%.1fs)' % (time.time() - t))

# decoded byte budget: 32 MiB + 1 of csv
t = time.time()
pad = HEADER + ('icmp,a,0,1,put,home,1,0/i1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,echo,,,\n')
filler = b'#' * (32 * 1024 * 1024 - len(pad) + 1)
raw = pad.encode() + filler
check('decoded > 32 MiB', run(campaign(leases=[lease()], services=[], captures=[
    {'encoding': 'csv', 'chunks': [base64.b64encode(raw[i:i+1048576]).decode()
                                   for i in range(0, len(raw), 1048576)]}]),
    expect_error='capture'), {'error': 'capture'})
print('  (%.1fs)' % (time.time() - t))

# decompressed budget with zstd: >128 MiB of highly compressible csv
t = time.time()
line = ('icmp,a,0,1,put,home,1,0/i1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,echo,,,\n' * 100)
blocks = line * 1400            # ~112 MiB when decompressed, tiny compressed
body = HEADER + blocks
compressed = zstd.ZstdCompressor(level=19).compress(body.encode())
print('  compressed %.2f MiB, decompressed %.1f MiB' % (len(compressed)/1048576, len(body)/1048576))
res = run(campaign(leases=[lease()], services=[], captures=[
    {'encoding': 'zstd', 'chunks': [base64.b64encode(compressed).decode()]}]))
print('  112MiB decompressed ->', 'capture error' if res == {'error': 'capture'} else 'accepted, %.1fs' % (time.time()-t))
PYEOF
